AIMelee checks target/drag/dig state, applies ordinary damage with unchecked result, may heal a low-health target under brood flag, and applies sting2400 for arthropods with amplifier1 when bred. Message handler resolves runtime entity IDs and applies default amplifier0; it is not server brood proof. Melee stop clears bredBuryFlag, so NBT persistence alone does not guarantee an uninterrupted brood cycle.

Paralyzed target plus sand position may be forced to ride the hawk; AIBury selects sand with bounded15 random attempts, digs for<200 ticks and moves target down at most3 blocks. This movement/support chain does not gate the effect expiry baby-add sink. Ordinary arthropod sting or brood flags/dragging must not be confused with verified reproductive success.

Actual ServerEvents subscription denies AllowDespawn when sting amplifier>0; effect is registered on the mod bus and ServerEvents on Forge bus. Denial is a temporary host lifecycle rule, not bypass of NaturalSpawner global/local capacity or proof of survival against every removal source.

Effect stores queried duration in shared lastDuration. For arthropods, final duration1 triggers unchecked damage and for amplifier>0 creates baby, searches upward for one empty block bounded by hardcoded256, and server finalizes BREEDING then attempts addFreshEntity; returned add/damage results are ignored. No mandatory host death, sand, parent UUID binding, full bounding-box clearance or spawn rules check at sink.

Expiry restores gravity/physics there, but removeAttributeModifiers only calls attribute super for arthropods. Early cleanse cleanup is not proven. BreedFlag persists, while goal sand/dig/target and shared duration are not explicit additional saved fields. Native effect dispatch/goal scheduler not studied here, so no claim of demonstrated cross-host duration race or runtime failure.
